skills.description: This skill should be used when the user uploads a person's chat history (WeChat export .txt/.zip) together with that person's avatar or photos, and wants a '人物性格卡片' (character profile card) generated from the conversation. It covers reading/analyzing the chat to extract grounded personality traits, preparing the avatar, and rendering a dual-column profile card (avatar + 9 trait fields on the left, a six-dimension personality model on the right) via the bundled Pillow renderer. Triggers include phrases like '生成人物性格卡片', '根据聊天记录做人设卡', or any request to turn chat logs + photos into a personality profile.
skills.description_zh: 微信聊天记录性格小卡片生成器 —— 上传聊天记录，自动分析性格并渲染成一张精美的分享卡片。
skills.name: wechat-character-card
